planets.name: TOI-5300 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5300 with a 2.26-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5300 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5300. Its orbit and size follow Frensch et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
